start: Selected final weights, optimizer reset because old optimizer state was not archived
history: Epochs1-20 are new measured replays compared with the preserved original log; epochs21 onward reload the exact old selected final checkpoint and start a new optimizer. Stage boundary explicitly marked.
LR_strategy: Halve LR after four consecutive validation-loss checks without improvement of1e-4; min1e-7.
epoch_definition: 32 minibatches /64augmented draws, retained from the original run; not a full200-view sweep
best_rule: Original selected model remains eligible. Require original-validation fixed-threshold Dice gain>1e-4, original-baseline Precision/Recall decrease<=0.005 and validation loss<=baseline+0.01
validation_loss: Actual unaugmented full original-validation eval-mode data objective measured on every replay and continuation epoch. Original historical validation-loss records did not exist and remain absent from the preserved old histories.
historical_loss_policy: All original histories retained unchanged. Replayed train/validation losses are separately labelled actual replay measurements, never original historical loss records. All20epochs and deviations are reported, regardless of whether better.
replay_consistency_description: Training relative-loss difference <=1% and archived validation Dice difference <=0.005 classify near replay; actual differences are reported and are not tuned to meet a score.

replay_threads.deeplab: See runtime_updates for completed-epoch thread configurations.

runtime_updates: TF completed replay epoch1: intra2/OMP2; epochs2-3: intra4/OMP4; epoch4: intra4/OMP1.
From completed checkpoint4, remaining TF work uses intra1/OMP4/MKL4. Completed checkpoint epochs were not replayed again.
Checkpoint files use uncompressed NPZ for faster atomic saves. Original data/objective and optimization schedules are unchanged; numerical replay differences are reported.
figure_policy: Use explicitly labelled20epoch replay in the primary loss figure only if both advance proximity flags pass. Otherwise retain archived original training loss and leave original validation loss missing; provide a separate full measured replay+continuation audit figure. All deviations remain in the tables.
